title: Average acceleration calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student correctly calculates the average angular acceleration as 2 r/s² using Δn/t.

title: Unit conversion accuracy
description: Essential Criteria: Student converts 600 r/min to 10 r/s for use in calculations.

title: Total revolutions determination
description: Essential Criteria: Student correctly calculates the total revolutions as 25 revolutions.

title: Average speed concept
description: Important Criteria: Student recognizes that for uniform acceleration, average rotational speed is (n₀+n_t)/2.

title: Kinematic approach
description: Important Criteria: Student applies appropriate rotational kinematics (q = n_avg × t) to find total revolutions.

title: Units in final answers
description: Optional Criteria: Student includes proper units (r/s² and r) with numerical answers.

title: Incorrect unit conversion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student fails to convert 600 r/min to r/s or makes conversion error.

title: Confusing acceleration with speed
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly reports average rotational speed (5 r/s) instead of average acceleration (2 r/s²) for part (1).
